QuestInfo.name: You Surpass Me
QuestInfo.0: You have returned to the Underground Base with #p2151001#. Talk to #b#p2151001##k to see if he's fully recovered.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2151001# says he's made a full recovery, but suspects you've fully surpassed him. He passes down his strongest skill--one so mighty, even he's never been able to master it.

Become a Resistance member worthy of his hopes.
Drive the Black Wings out of town and find peace!
QuestInfo.2:
#p2151001# says he's made a full recovery, but doesn't think he can ever surpass your prowess. Then, he passes the strongest skill he knows on to you, saying he's never been able to perfect it, but believes that you can.

Become a Resistance member who can meet his expectations. 
Drive the Black Wings out of town and find peace!
